declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationTail.firstEvent
declarations.header: def firstEvent (Y : Ω → List I) (a : I) : Set Ω

declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationTail.firstEvent_inter_tail
declarations.header:
theorem firstEvent_inter_tail (Y : Ω → List I) (a : I) (xs : List I) :
    firstEvent Y a ∩ {ω | (Y ω).tail = xs} = {ω | Y ω = a :: xs}

declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationTail.cons_mem_orders
declarations.header:
theorem cons_mem_orders (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup)
    (S : Finset I) (a : I) (haPositions : a ∈ positions) (ha : a ∈ S)
    (xs : List I) :
    a :: xs ∈ orders positions S ↔ xs ∈ orders positions (S.erase a)

declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationTail.tail_restrictedOrder_eq
declarations.header:
theorem tail_restrictedOrder_eq (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup)
    (S : Finset I) (a : I) (π : Equiv.Perm I)
    (hfirst : π ∈ firstEvent (restrictedOrder positions S) a) :
    (restrictedOrder positions S π).tail =
      restrictedOrder positions (S.erase a) π

declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationTail.filter_tail_restrictedOrder_eq
declarations.header:
theorem filter_tail_restrictedOrder_eq (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup)
    (S : Finset I) (a : I) (π : Equiv.Perm I)
    (hfirst : π ∈ firstEvent (restrictedOrder positions S) a)
    (T : Finset I) (hT : T ⊆ S.erase a) :
    (restrictedOrder positions S π).tail.filter (fun b => decide (b ∈ T)) =
      restrictedOrder positions T π

declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationTail.firstEvent_restrictedOrder_of_not_mem
declarations.header:
theorem firstEvent_restrictedOrder_of_not_mem (positions : List I)
    (S : Finset I) (a : I) (ha : a ∉ S) :
    firstEvent (restrictedOrder positions S) a = ∅

declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationTail.cond_firstEvent_restrictedOrder_of_not_mem
declarations.header:
theorem cond_firstEvent_restrictedOrder_of_not_mem
    [MeasurableSpace (Equiv.Perm I)]
    (positions : List I) (S : Finset I) (a : I) (ha : a ∉ S)
    (μ : Measure (Equiv.Perm I)) :
    μ[|firstEvent (restrictedOrder positions S) a] = 0

declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationTail.factorial_card_erase
Applications.Probability.PermutationTail.factorial_ratio_head
Applications.Probability.PermutationTail.factorial_ratio_tail
Applications.Probability.PermutationTail.uniformOn_firstEvent
declarations.header:
theorem uniformOn_firstEvent
    [MeasurableSpace (Equiv.Perm I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Equiv.Perm I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ b, b ∈ positions)
    (S : Finset I) (a : I) (ha : a ∈ S) :
    uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (Equiv.Perm I))
        (firstEvent (restrictedOrder positions S) a) = (S.card : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹

declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationTail.cond_uniformOn_firstEvent
declarations.header:
theorem cond_uniformOn_firstEvent
    [MeasurableSpace (Equiv.Perm I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Equiv.Perm I)]
    (positions : List I) (hcomplete : ∀ b, b ∈ positions) (S : Finset I) (a : I) :
    (uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (Equiv.Perm I)))[|
        firstEvent (restrictedOrder positions S) a] =
      uniformOn (firstEvent (restrictedOrder positions S) a)

declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationTail.cond_tail_eq
declarations.header:
theorem cond_tail_eq
    [MeasurableSpace (Equiv.Perm I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Equiv.Perm I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ b, b ∈ positions)
    (S : Finset I) (a : I) (ha : a ∈ S) (xs : List I) :
    (uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (Equiv.Perm I)))[|
        firstEvent (restrictedOrder positions S) a]
        {π | (restrictedOrder positions S π).tail = xs} =
      if xs ∈ orders positions (S.erase a)
      then (Nat.factorial (S.erase a).card : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹
      else 0

declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationTail.map_tail_cond_first
declarations.header:
theorem map_tail_cond_first
    [MeasurableSpace (Equiv.Perm I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Equiv.Perm I)]
    [MeasurableSpace (List I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (List I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ b, b ∈ positions)
    (S : Finset I) (a : I) (ha : a ∈ S) :
    ((uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (Equiv.Perm I)))[|
        firstEvent (restrictedOrder positions S) a]).map
        (fun π => (restrictedOrder positions S π).tail) =
      uniformOn (orders positions (S.erase a) : Set (List I))

declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationTail.restrictedOrder_hasLaw
declarations.header:
private theorem restrictedOrder_hasLaw
    [MeasurableSpace (Equiv.Perm I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Equiv.Perm I)]
    [MeasurableSpace (List I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (List I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ b, b ∈ positions)
    (S : Finset I) :
    HasLaw (restrictedOrder positions S)
      (uniformOn (orders positions S : Set (List I)))
      (uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (Equiv.Perm I)))

declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationTail.hasLaw_cond
declarations.header:
private theorem hasLaw_cond {A B : Type*} [MeasurableSpace A] [MeasurableSpace B]
    {μ : Measure A} {ν : Measure B} {Y : A → B}
    (hY : HasLaw Y ν μ) (H : Set B) (hH : MeasurableSet H) :
    HasLaw Y (ν[|H]) (μ[|Y ⁻¹' H])

declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationTail.orders_head_mass
declarations.header:
private theorem orders_head_mass
    [MeasurableSpace (List I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (List I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ b, b ∈ positions)
    (S : Finset I) (a : I) (ha : a ∈ S) :
    uniformOn (orders positions S : Set (List I))
      (firstEvent (id : List I → List I) a) = (S.card : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹

declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationTail.head_mass_of_hasLaw
declarations.header:
theorem head_mass_of_hasLaw
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace (List I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (List I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ b, b ∈ positions)
    (S : Finset I) (a : I) (ha : a ∈ S)
    {μ : Measure Ω} {Y : Ω → List I}
    (hY : HasLaw Y (uniformOn (orders positions S : Set (List I))) μ) :
    μ (firstEvent Y a) = (S.card : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹

declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationTail.tail_hasLaw_orders_cond
declarations.header:
private theorem tail_hasLaw_orders_cond
    [MeasurableSpace (List I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (List I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ b, b ∈ positions)
    (S : Finset I) (a : I) (ha : a ∈ S) :
    HasLaw (List.tail : List I → List I)
      (uniformOn (orders positions (S.erase a) : Set (List I)))
      ((uniformOn (orders positions S : Set (List I)))[|
        firstEvent (id : List I → List I) a])

declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationTail.hasLaw_tail_cond_first
declarations.header:
theorem hasLaw_tail_cond_first
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace (List I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (List I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ b, b ∈ positions)
    (S : Finset I) (a : I) (ha : a ∈ S)
    {μ : Measure Ω} {Y : Ω → List I}
    (hY : HasLaw Y (uniformOn (orders positions S : Set (List I))) μ) :
    HasLaw (fun ω => (Y ω).tail)
      (uniformOn (orders positions (S.erase a) : Set (List I)))
      (μ[|firstEvent Y a])

declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationTail.filter_hasLaw_orders
declarations.header:
private theorem filter_hasLaw_orders
    [MeasurableSpace (List I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (List I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ b, b ∈ positions)
    (S T : Finset I) (hT : T ⊆ S) :
    HasLaw (fun xs : List I => xs.filter (fun b => decide (b ∈ T)))
      (uniformOn (orders positions T : Set (List I)))
      (uniformOn (orders positions S : Set (List I)))

declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationTail.hasLaw_filter_tail_cond_first
declarations.header:
theorem hasLaw_filter_tail_cond_first
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace (List I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (List I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ b, b ∈ positions)
    (S : Finset I) (a : I) (ha : a ∈ S)
    {μ : Measure Ω} {Y : Ω → List I}
    (hY : HasLaw Y (uniformOn (orders positions S : Set (List I))) μ)
    (T : Finset I) (hT : T ⊆ S.erase a) :
    HasLaw (fun ω => (Y ω).tail.filter (fun b => decide (b ∈ T)))
      (uniformOn (orders positions T : Set (List I)))
      (μ[|firstEvent Y a])

declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationTail.map_restrictedOrder_cond_first
declarations.header:
theorem map_restrictedOrder_cond_first
    [MeasurableSpace (Equiv.Perm I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Equiv.Perm I)]
    [MeasurableSpace (List I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (List I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ b, b ∈ positions)
    (S : Finset I) (a : I) (ha : a ∈ S) (T : Finset I) (hT : T ⊆ S.erase a) :
    ((uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (Equiv.Perm I)))[|
        firstEvent (restrictedOrder positions S) a]).map (restrictedOrder positions T) =
      uniformOn (orders positions T : Set (List I))
